251	 * @param personaMeta      Per-persona YAML as a plain record
   252	 * @param sharedMeta       Parsed `_shared.yaml` fields
   253	 * @param agentMap         Cross-suite agent name map (injected by build())

   260	 * @returns                Merged rendering context

   262	function buildContext(
   263	  personaMeta: Record<string, unknown>,
   264	  sharedMeta: Record<string, unknown>,
   265	  agentMap: Record<string, string> = {},
   266	  target?: TargetType,
   267	  registry?: TargetRegistry,
   268	  configVariables?: Record<string, unknown>,
   269	  suiteVariables?: Record<string, unknown>,
   270	): Record<string, unknown> {
   271	  const version =
   272	    typeof personaMeta['version'] === 'string'
   273	      ? personaMeta['version']
   274	      : typeof sharedMeta['default_version'] === 'string'
   275	        ? sharedMeta['default_version']
   276	        : '0.0.0';
   277	
   278	  // Merge base: configVariables first (lowest priority), then suiteVariables,
   279	  // then sharedMeta, then personaMeta (highest priority among YAML sources).
   280	  const merged: Record<string, unknown> = {
   281	    ...(configVariables ?? {}),
   282	    ...(suiteVariables ?? {}),
   283	    ...sharedMeta,
   284	    ...personaMeta,
   285	    version,
   286	  };
   287	
   288	  // ── Derived convenience fields (only set when not already provided) ───────
   289	  // tools_list / tools_json — serialized from the `tools` array if present
   290	  const tools = Array.isArray(merged['tools']) ? (merged['tools'] as string[]) : [];
   291	  if (!('tools_list' in merged)) {
   292	    merged['tools_list'] = serializeToolsList(tools);
   293	  }
   294	  if (!('tools_json' in merged)) {
   295	    merged['tools_json'] = serializeTools(tools);
   296	  }
   297	
   298	  // cc_tools_list / cc_tools_json — from `cc_tools` or fall back to `tools`
   299	  const ccTools = Array.isArray(merged['cc_tools']) ? (merged['cc_tools'] as string[]) : tools;
   300	  if (!('cc_tools_list' in merged)) {
   301	    merged['cc_tools_list'] = serializeToolsList(ccTools);
   302	  }
   303	  if (!('cc_tools_json' in merged)) {
   304	    merged['cc_tools_json'] = serializeTools(ccTools);
   305	  }
   306	
   307	  // cc_file_name_stem — stem of cc_file_name (for default CC frontmatter template)
   308	  if (!('cc_file_name_stem' in merged) && typeof merged['cc_file_name'] === 'string') {
   309	    const ccFileName = merged['cc_file_name'] as string;
   310	    merged['cc_file_name_stem'] = ccFileName.replace(/\.md$/, '');
   311	  }
   312	
   313	  // da_file_name_stem — stem of da_file_name (for deep-agents output)
   314	  if (!('da_file_name_stem' in merged) && typeof merged['da_file_name'] === 'string') {
   315	    const daFileName = merged['da_file_name'] as string;
   316	    merged['da_file_name_stem'] = daFileName.replace(/\.md$/, '');
   317	  }
   318	
   319	  // da_tools_list / da_tools_json — from `da_tools` or fall back to `tools`
   320	  // Intentionally gated on da_file_name: unlike cc_tools_list/cc_tools_json (always emitted for
   321	  // every persona), da_* fields are absent when the persona has no deep-agents output file (AC-4).
   322	  if (typeof merged['da_file_name'] === 'string') {
   323	    const daTools = Array.isArray(merged['da_tools']) ? (merged['da_tools'] as string[]) : tools;
   324	    if (!('da_tools_list' in merged)) {
   325	      merged['da_tools_list'] = serializeToolsList(daTools);
   326	    }
   327	    if (!('da_tools_json' in merged)) {
   328	      merged['da_tools_json'] = serializeTools(daTools);
   329	    }

   333	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(agentMap)) {

   340	  if (target !== undefined) {

   360	/**
   361	 * Build a single persona for a single output target.
   362	 *
   363	 * Pipeline:
   364	 *   1. Load sharedMeta + personaMeta (callers supply pre-loaded values)
   365	 *   2. Build merged context
   366	 *   3. Run onBuildContext plugin hooks (context accumulation)
   367	 *   3.5. Run onPersonaPartials plugin hooks (shallow-copy partials map, persona-scoped)
   368	 *   4. Resolve frontmatter template → render frontmatter
   369	 *   5. Load content template
   370	 *   6. Render body: partials → conditionals → variables → post-process
   371	 *   7. Assemble final output (frontmatter + body)
   372	 *   8. Run onPostRender plugin hooks (output chain)
   373	 *   9. Run onValidate plugin hooks (validation collection)
   374	 *  10. Determine output file path
   375	 *  11. Write output file (unless check mode)
   376	 *  12. Return BuildResult
   377	 *
   378	 * @param personaYamlPath  Absolute path to the persona YAML source file
   379	 * @param suiteName        Identifier for the suite this persona belongs to
   380	 * @param suiteConfig      Suite configuration object. `suiteConfig.variables`
   381	 *                         is forwarded to `buildContext()` as the
   382	 *                         `suiteVariables` layer (layer 2 of 7) — these values
   383	 *                         override any `config.variables` but are themselves
   384	 *                         overridden by `_shared.yaml` and per-persona fields.
   385	 * @param sharedMeta       Pre-loaded `_shared.yaml` contents
   386	 * @param partialsMap      Pre-loaded partials map (shared + suite-local merged)
   387	 * @param config           Top-level BuildConfig. `config.variables` is
   388	 *                         forwarded to `buildContext()` as the
   389	 *                         `configVariables` layer (layer 1 of 7, lowest
   390	 *                         priority) — global defaults available to every
   391	 *                         persona across all suites.
   392	 * @param plugins          Registered plugins
   393	 * @param target           Target output format
   394	 * @param agentMap         Pre-built cross-suite agent name map
   395	 * @param registry         Target registry to use. Defaults to `defaultRegistry`.
   396	 *   **Two-registry limitation:** If you pass a custom `TargetRegistry` only
   397	 *   to `build()` (via `config.targetRegistry`) and call `buildPersona()`
   398	 *   directly without also passing that registry here, your custom targets
   399	 *   will not be visible — `defaultRegistry` will be used instead. Either
   400	 *   pass the same registry instance explicitly, or call `build()` to have
   401	 *   the registry forwarded automatically.
   402	 * @returns                BuildResult for this persona × target combination
   403	 */
   404	export async function buildPersona(
   405	  personaYamlPath: string,
   406	  suiteName: string,
   407	  suiteConfig: SuiteConfig,
   408	  sharedMeta: Record<string, unknown>,
   409	  partialsMap: Record<string, string>,
   410	  config: BuildConfig,
   411	  plugins: PersonaBuildPlugin[],
   412	  target: string,
   413	  agentMap: Record<string, string> = {},
   414	  registry: TargetRegistry = defaultRegistry,
   415	): Promise<BuildResult> {
   416	  // ── 1. Load persona metadata ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   417	  const personaMeta = await loadPersonaYaml(personaYamlPath);
   418	
   419	  // ── 2. Build merged context ───────────────────────────────────────────────
   420	  let context = buildContext(
   421	    personaMeta,
   422	    sharedMeta,
   423	    agentMap,
   424	    target,
   425	    registry,
   426	    config.variables,
   427	    suiteConfig.variables,
   428	  );
   429	
   430	  // ── 3. Plugin onBuildContext ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   431	  // Cast context to PersonaMetadata for the plugin runner (it requires a
   432	  // name field which is guaranteed by loadPersonaYaml above).
   433	  const personaMetaTyped = personaMeta as PersonaMetadata;
   434	  context = runBuildContext(plugins, context, personaMetaTyped, suiteConfig, target);
   435	
   436	  // ── 3.5. Plugin onPersonaPartials ─────────────────────────────────────────
   437	  // Create a shallow copy of the suite-level partials map so that any
   438	  // persona-level overrides or injections do not leak to other personas.
   439	  // The copy is then mutated (accumulated) by onPersonaPartials plugins and
   440	  // used exclusively for this persona's rendering pass.
   441	  const personaPartialsMap = runPersonaPartials(
   442	    plugins,
   443	    { ...partialsMap },
   444	    personaMetaTyped,
   445	    context,
   446	    suiteConfig,
   447	    target,
   448	  );
   449	
   450	  // ── 4. Render frontmatter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
